title: Claudio Valente quits his job and vanishes

tellings.quote: One day in 2013, Valente reported to work. He declared it would be his last day.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, telling a story about scientists who go missing, says that one day in 2013 a man named Claudio Valente showed up at work in Portugal, at a place called SAPO, and declared it would be his last day. According to Michels, Valente then vanished, and he tells it as part of a pattern of puzzling disappearances.
